semantic_and_terminology_invariants: The ideal, graded prime ideal, radical, nilradical, nilpotent element, quotient ring, and homogeneous-component objects in 2.1.10 retain their distinct mathematical roles.
Essentially reduced is rendered as 본질적으로 축소 and is bound to the absence of nonzero nilpotent elements in S_+.
Zero divisor is rendered as 영인자 and essentially integral as 본질적으로 정역 without conflating either with an ordinary integral-domain assertion.
Canonical line 1638 is rendered universally: every nonzero homogeneous element of S_+ must be a non-zero-divisor; an existential weakening is not admitted.
The annihilator argument preserves the existence of one homogeneous f, the universal quantifier over g, and the final necessary-and-sufficient condition on S_0.
The localization, degree-zero subring, Laurent polynomial, and localized graded-module constructions retain all degree shifts and scalar rings.
The système libre phrase is rendered 자유계, not 기저, so linear independence is asserted without an unjustified spanning-as-a-basis claim.
The exponent h ranges over every integer including zero; the candidate states this explicitly and retains the Laurent family and its linear-independence proof.
